featured_reviews.name: Sneha Soneji
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was visiting a relative in Goregaon when I saw the Huckleberry store. Thought of picking up some bakery items for home.

Huckleberry has always been my favorite since my childhood. My uncle used to get me pastries from huckleberry every month. They are too soft and too fresh always.

They have a wide variety of bakery items like cakes, muffins, toasts.

What I got..

I always prefer pastries over cakes as we can try a variety of them.

Blueberry Pastry : Fresh, soft pastry. The blueberry flavor really came through. My mom dad absolutely loved it.

Dark Chocolate Truffle Pastry : I chose this one for myself. The dark chocolate was really amazing. Again, the sponge was very soft and chocolate was fresh.

Banana Muffin : I never had banana muffin earlier and the person there said I should try it. I would say I rather loved it. Was very hesitant but the taste is really really good. Its not too sweet, not too dense. Its soft. Perfect combo for coffee.

Marble Cake : My cousins love these cake and so I got this for them. Soft fresh cake, we had it with tea.

Tea Toasts : Toast is something that I love with tea and I have it almost every evening. This one was a new variant which I had never tried so thought to get this. This has become my new favorite now. After dipping in the tea, the taste of the toast just enhances. This also has a few. dryfruits in them.

Everything is priced really reasonably. The staff was very patient when I was asking about their pastries and cakes.
